call_points.text: Management expects FY27 revenue to grow 10% to 15%, gross margins around 35%, and EBITDA margins of 18% to 20%.
Europe volume grew approximately 16% in FY26, with management guiding for a similar growth trend in FY27.
Europe delivered gross margins of 41.5% in Q4FY26 and 42.5% for the full year FY26.
Product registrations stood at 3,011 with an additional 1,004 applications in the pipeline as of March 31, 2026.
CFO guided for an effective tax rate between 18% to 20% for FY27 and FY28.
FY26 gross margins were 25% in NAFTA, 25% in LATAM, and 43% in Rest of the World.
Forex loss reported in Q4 was primarily unrealized, resulting from realignment of foreign currency payables on the last day.
Non-agrochemical segment is expected to grow by 5% to 10% in FY27, backed by improved demand for made-to-order conveyor belts.
Gross margins improved 600 bps to 35.9% in FY26 and are expected to remain at these levels in FY27.
Q4FY26 gross margin reached 37.3% (up 750 bps) and is expected to remain at this level in FY27.
Company procured 3,011 registrations and has 1,004 applications pending at different stages globally.
Europe remained largest agrochemical market in FY26 at ₹2,981 Cr (+37% YoY), contributing 63% of agrochemical revenue.

timeline.summary: Ramprakash V. Bubna and promoter group (6 members) declared no share encumbrance under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26, filed 2nd April 2026.
Ramprakash V. Bubna, Promoter, declares no promoter group shares encumbered under SEBI Takeover Regulations as of March 31, 2025.
Ramprakash V. Bubna, as promoter of Sharda Cropchem Limited, declared no encumbrances on promoter group shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026 on 2026-04-02.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,870.77 Cr, net profit ₹352.4 Cr.
Sharda Cropchem reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹2,065 Cr and FY26 PAT of ₹681 Cr, recommending a final dividend of ₹9 per share.
Sharda Cropchem released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation guiding for FY27 gross margins to hold at FY26 levels (~36%).
Sharda Cropchem Limited’s Board of Directors, led by **JETKIN GUDHKA**, recommended a final dividend of ₹9 per equity share for FY2025-26 on May 13, 2026.
Sharda Cropchem Limited hosted a Q4 FY 2025-26 earnings conference call for analysts and investors on May 14, 2026, at 1:00 PM IST via digital link.
Sharda Cropchem hosted its Q4FY26 concall, guiding for 10-15% revenue growth and 18-20% EBITDA margin in FY27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,051.68 Cr (+13.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹91.79 Cr (+23.5% YoY).
Sharda Cropchem reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue growth of 13% YoY to ₹1,051.7 Cr, with EBITDA margins expanding to 15.6%.
